mainEntity.name: How do I choose between different types of kitchen water filtration systems?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing a kitchen water filtration system depends on your specific needs, such as taste improvement, removal of contaminants, or overall water quality concerns. Options include under-sink filters, whole-house systems, and faucet-mounted filters. Under-sink models offer convenience and higher filtration capacity for drinking water, while whole-house systems treat all water entering your home. Consider the type of contaminants you want to remove and the installation complexity. We can help assess your water quality to recommend the best solution.
